MINING THE WHITE SALT HILLS OF RUMANIA.

A scene 400 feet down in the salt mines of Slanicu, Rumania, where 80,000 tons of dalt are mined every year. The industry, which is State controlled, has been flourishing for centuries, and was probably first worked by the ancient Romans. Great slabs of salt are obtained by driving in a line of wedges simultaneously.

MINING THE WHITE SALT HILLS OF RUMANIA.

Workmen using an electric drill in the immense salt mines at Slanicu, Rumania. These mines, which are controlled by the State, produce 80,000 tons of salt per year, and have been worked for centuries, probably by the Romans.

ROMANTIAN PALACE BURNT DOWN.

The old Romanian Royal palace built by the late King Carol, was damaged by fire last night. The centre section of the palace, containing the banqueting and reception rooms and offices was burnt out, but soldiers and guards managed to save the furniture and pictures, most of which were heirleoms. The damage is estimated at about £16,000. O.P.S. The old Romanian royal palace in Bucharest, SSS.

THE EYE OF THE BALKANS. This interesting photograph shows more of the present Balkan theatre of war than perhaps any other view contains. In a bend of the Danube is seen the low island Ada-Kaleh; on the right the last spur of Serbia; and Rumania and Hungary in the background, divided by the valley in which lies Orsova, whose capture by the Rumanians is of immense strategic importance.

WITH THE BRITISH ARMOURED CAR SQUARDRON IN THE CAUCASUS, Splendid work has been done by the British armoured car squadrons which has been operating with the Russians against the Turks in the Caucasus. After being ice-bound for months in the Arctic, crossed European-Russia and doing good work there against the Turks they have now appeared in action side by side with the Russo-Rumanian Armies. Photo Shows, Some of the difficulties of the "roads" in the Caucasus.

Romania,it would appear, is suffering amputation of its western area, known as Oltenie, and the situation is an anxious one. Every reports state that battalion cut off on the western frontier are fighting stubbornly. General Avarasco is in command of the north-western group, and the photographs show what fine types of men he has under him. Our Photo shows, Prince Chica in his motor at the front.
